abort.single_instance_allowed: Automation Pause and Resume is already set up.

user.description: Pause any automation for a set time. It turns on again by itself.

data_description.dashboard: Adds a dashboard to the sidebar that lists all automations. You can pause and resume them there. You can add or remove it later under Configure.
data_description.dashboard_title: The name of the dashboard in the sidebar.

init.title: Dashboard
init.description: The dashboard in the sidebar. You can edit it like any other dashboard.

data_description.dashboard: Off removes the dashboard and your edits to it.
data_description.dashboard_title: The name in the sidebar. A new name applies after you save; the dashboard content stays.
data_description.dashboard_rebuild: Builds the dashboard again and discards your edits.

not_loaded.message: Automation Pause and Resume is not loaded.

no_id.message: {entity_id} has no id. Add an id: to this automation in YAML. Without it, a restart or reload turns the automation on again.

already_off.message: {entity_id} is already off. There is nothing to pause.

duration_too_short.message: A pause must be at least 1 minute.

duration_too_long.message: A pause can be at most 365 days.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Turns automations off for a set time. When the time ends, they turn on again.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the automations stay off. From 1 minute to 365 days. A second pause replaces the end time.

stop_actions.name: Stop actions
stop_actions.description: Stops the actions that are running now.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Ends the pause now and turns the automations on again.
